title: da workflow hook outcome sidecar
description: Schema for .agents/active/iteration-log/iter-N.hook-outcomes.yaml (schema_version 1). One file per iteration containing an ordered list of HookOutcome records — one per evaluated sentinel-anchored hook invocation in the iteration window. Defined by r1-5-hook-enforcement-telemetry design D2. Records are bounded telemetry: transcript text, raw tool input/output, command bodies, and unbounded failure messages are explicitly disallowed (see Boundary section of the spec).

schema_version.description: Schema version. v1 is the initial contract per D2.

records.description: Ordered list of HookOutcome records appended in iteration order. Append idempotency is keyed on (sentinel_id, rule_id, lifecycle_point, intervention_class) per R2.3.

hookOutcome.description: A single hook-outcome record. Fields are per D2; disallowed fields (transcript_excerpt, tool_input, tool_output, stdout, stderr, command_args, failure_message beyond bounded classification) are excluded by additionalProperties=false and reinforced by the propertyNames check below.

schema_version.description: Per-record schema version; mirrors the top-level value so a record copied out of the sidecar (e.g. for CLI readback) is self-describing.

sentinel_id.description: Stable identifier of the form <skill>-<run-id> that joins this record to the archived sentinel under .agents/history/<plan-id>/hook-sentinels/<YYYY-MM-DD>/.

skill.description: Skill whose sentinel this outcome is anchored to.

lifecycle_point.description: Platform lifecycle event at which this record was emitted. Required together with intervention_class per R1.3.

intervention_class.description: Classification of the gate's intervention semantics. Required together with lifecycle_point per R1.3; the pair distinguishes a single (sentinel_id, rule_id) record from any other emission for the same intent.

result.description: Gate outcome severity. allow = no action needed; advise = non-blocking guidance recorded; remediate = enforced correction.

rule_id.description: Stable rule identifier such as iteration-close.R1.1 or loop-worker.R3.1. The namespace prefix groups by gate; the suffix is the spec-defined rule code.

platform.description: Agent platform that produced the sentinel.

ts.description: RFC3339 timestamp at which the gate evaluated the outcome.

archived_sentinel_path.description: POSIX path relative to the repo root pointing at the archived sentinel. Empty string for pre_tool_use records written before the sentinel archives.

correlation_id.description: Groups pre-action and terminal records emitted for the same intent (per D4). Defaults to sentinel_id when only one record exists for the intent.

allOf.description: R1.3: lifecycle_point and intervention_class must appear together. Enforced via required, but restated here to make the cross-field invariant explicit for tooling.
